name: deval
description: Run DeepEval TypeScript test suites to evaluate your agent behavior.

chatParticipants.name: deval
chatParticipants.description: A chat harness for evaluating agent behavior with DeepEval suites.

languageModelTools.name: deval_readFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads the full text contents of a file in the workspace. Input: { path: workspace-relative file path }.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to read, e.g. "src/extension.ts".

languageModelTools.name: deval_listFiles
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the files and directories directly inside a workspace folder, non-recursive. Input: { directory?: workspace-relative directory, defaults to the workspace root }.

directory.description: Workspace-relative directory to list. Defaults to the workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: deval_grep
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches file contents for a text pattern across the workspace and returns matching lines. Input: { pattern: text or regular expression to search for, directory?: workspace-relative directory to search }.

pattern.description: The text or regular expression to search for.

directory.description: Workspace-relative directory to search. Defaults to the workspace root.

deval.deepevalCommand.description: Executable used to launch the DeepEval TypeScript test runner.

deval.packageManager.description: Package manager the Scaffold Sample Benchmark command uses to install deepeval and vitest.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.compile-tests: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p . --outDir out
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
